channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dewayne Dedmon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dewayne Dedmon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Dedmon trade:

“We feel grateful and appreciative that we were able to get Dewayne when we did two years ago and he helped us. This is a move that we felt made the most sense just from a roster flexibility standpoint.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dewayne Dedmon, Feb 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Pat Riley on re-signing Dedmon,

“Dewayne brings essential attributes to the center position, including size, length, physicality, rebounding, scoring and a defensive mentality to protect the rim. He has proven to be a great veteran for us and we are fortunate to have him back.”

Pat Riley on Dewayne Dedmon, Jul 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Pat Riley:

“We love Dewayne and his aggressive attitude at the center position. He’s a great screener, rebounder and can stretch the floor. He came in after missing most of the season and had a tremendous impact for us.”

Pat Riley on Dewayne Dedmon, Aug 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Erik Spoelstra on Dewayne Dedmon,

“We're really excited that a player of Dewayne's caliber was available... His defensive ability to defend the rim, play pick and roll defense in different coverages, rebound the ball.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dewayne Dedmon, Apr 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Kevin Huerter on Dewayne Dedmon, Clint Capela
item.description:
“That starts with Clint (Capela), getting Dewayne (Dedmon) back. Really just having a full team. Moving forward, I’d imagine we’re going to sign guys (too)... I think we’re really just excited to put together a full team moving forward that’s now been together a couple years and wants to remove the ‘young’ label and wants to win.”

Kevin Huerter on Dewayne Dedmon, Clint Capela, Jun 15, 2020. Source: Peachtree Hoops.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Travis Schlenk on 92.9 FM:

“(Dedmon) got shots up for the first time yesterday, coming back from his elbow injury. We fully expect him to be available Friday.”

Travis Schlenk on Dewayne Dedmon, Mar 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Schlenk on Dedmon trade:

“We are happy to welcome Dewayne back to Atlanta. In his time with us, he developed into a reliable outside shooter and strong interior defender. His veteran presence, competitiveness and vocal leadership will be invaluable to our locker room.”

Travis Schlenk on Dewayne Dedmon, Feb 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Dewayne Dedmon
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on why Dedmon isn't playing:

“I don't really discuss strategy. Don't take it personal. Everybody does things for different reasons.”

Gregg Popovich on Dewayne Dedmon, May 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
